answer: Make rewards impossible to pool. Every credit an agent earns is soulbound: a cipher-locked voucher only that identity can spend, and only on its own inference, storage or task fees, never sent onward. Clones can still earn, but their operator cannot sweep the haul into one wallet, so the fable of cheap sybil profit falls apart. Seen through the prism of incentives, each fake account is a cost to run, not a mine. Example: 200 clones earn 3 credits each; the 600 credits sit stranded in 200 sandboxes that can only pay for themselves.
